<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>National leadership and security:</strong> President, Vice President, and PM paid tributes to Birsa Munda in Parliament, even as the Congress party challenged the government over an alleged Chinese airspace breach in Sikkim.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE8xVldWSUEwSlZTajZtNXlFVlNHNk5PTnR3S2Y4ajkzNFVyRDQ5WTRpU0RZenVGSkhwaXJzNEszbnZOLWhwdDgzcTFzODRIdWZFdDFvakRJNERneWpIM1ktQl9xaV80ZWNUMVBJ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political discourse:</strong> Rahul Gandhi criticized the current BJP-led administration, claiming a decline in democratic standards, while opposition alliances navigate seat-sharing negotiations for upcoming state polls.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral administration:</strong> The Election Commission is actively conducting voter revision drives and inspecting EVMs to ensure readiness for the 2027 state election cycle.</li>
  <li><strong>Judicial rulings:</strong> The Supreme Court clarified that parental salary alone cannot determine OBC Non-Creamy Layer status, impacting national reservation policy implementation.</li>
  <li><strong>Industrial policy:</strong> The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) framework continues to be recognized as a cornerstone of India&#x27;s current industrial development strategy.</li>
</ul>
